# Cooldown Manager Extras

![Cooldown Manager Extras in combat: Personal Resource Display with Essential and Utility Cooldowns attached below](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/main/docs/screenshots/01-hero.png)

**Blizzard's Cooldown Manager, with the options it's missing. You set it up where you
already do: in Edit Mode and in Cooldown Settings.**

This add-on adds no frames of its own and no options window to learn. The icons, bars and
Personal Resource Display stay Blizzard's. The extra options show up in Blizzard's own
panels, so the Cooldown Manager looks and works the way you know, with much more you can
change.

## Why this add-on

Most cooldown add-ons hide Blizzard's frames, draw their own, and make you set up
everything again in their own window. This add-on does not:

- **The same frames.** What Blizzard tracks, in which order, with which icons, stays as
  you set it in Cooldown Settings.
- **The same places.** Select a cooldown viewer or the Personal Resource Display in Edit
  Mode, and its settings panel has the new options. Open Cooldown Settings, and a **+**
  tile next to Blizzard's spells adds your own.
- **Built in, not bolted on.** Your own spells, trinkets, potions and buffs join
  Blizzard's icons in the same viewer, in the same look, at the place you pick. No extra
  bar to place next to it.
- **Pixel-perfect.** Borders are drawn in whole screen pixels, and attached frames line
  up edge to edge, at any UI scale. No blurry borders, no 1-pixel gaps.

Made for WoW Forever.

## Features

### Layout and anchoring

- **Center a row,** or let it grow from its left or right edge. Rows of buffs close the
  gaps of inactive icons.
- **Drag to attach.** In Edit Mode, drag a frame next to another one. A preview shows
  where it will attach; let go and it attaches. Hold Shift to move it freely.
- **Attach to anything in Edit Mode:** other viewers, the Personal Resource Display,
  action bars, unit frames, the cast bar and add-on frames, on any side, with a gap.
- **Width matching:** make a viewer, the Tracked Bars or the Personal Resource Display
  as wide as another one.
- **Pixel-perfect:** attached frames and matched widths line up to the pixel, at any UI
  scale.

### Your own cooldowns and buffs

- **Custom spells and items** in Essential or Utility Cooldowns: any spell, item
  (potions, healthstones) or trinket slot. Add them with the **+** tile in Cooldown
  Settings, or drop a spell or item on it.
- **Custom buffs** in Tracked Buffs: buffs your own trinkets, potions and spells start.
  Pick from the ones you have started, with their duration.
- **Also in combat:** the game hides buffs from add-ons in combat, so these are timed
  from your cast. That is why only buffs you start yourself can be added: buffs from other
  players and passive procs can't be shown in combat, so the add-on doesn't offer them.

### Look

- **Square icons** with pixel-exact borders, icon zoom, square cooldown swipes and an
  optional inner shadow. Debuff-type colors (Magic, Curse, ...) stay visible on the
  border.
- **Per-spell borders:** right-click a spell in Cooldown Settings to give it its own
  border color.
- **Fonts and textures** for timers, counts and bars (LibSharedMedia and Blizzard
  textures), and a square bar style.
- **Keybind text** on cooldown icons, read from Blizzard's action bars.

### Personal Resource Display

- Separate textures for the health and power bars.
- Health in class color or your own color.
- A color for each power type: turquoise mana, if you like.
- Texture and color for the cast cost preview.
- A square style: crisp border, background and inner shadow. Shading gives the bars a
  soft top-to-bottom gradient.
- Turn off the spend flash and the full-power glow.
- A five-second rule spark on the mana bar.

### Spell behavior

- **Show the cooldown, not the buff duration,** per spell, for spells that put a buff on
  you.
- **Gray out during a debuff,** per spell, for example Power Word: Shield while you have
  Weakened Soul.
- **Debuff timers** in Tracked Buffs, also in combat.

### Profiles and other add-ons

- **Profiles:** share a setup between characters and talent groups, and import or export
  it as text.
- **Masque:** not needed, and not built in. If you already skin the Cooldown Manager with
  Masque (through Masque Blizzard Bars), that keeps working: the icon look is then the
  skin's, and everything else here still works. For a similar look without Masque, use
  the Square style with an inner shadow; it stays pixel-perfect.

## Commands

- `/cme` lists the commands. `/cme options` opens profiles and import/export.
- `/cme status`, `/cme probe`, `/cme timers`, `/cme rings` and `/cme blocked` print what
  the add-on sees, for bug reports.
- `/cme probe spell|item|slot|aura <id>` shows what the game lets add-ons read about one
  cooldown or buff right now. Run it in combat.

`/cmp` works too.

## Development

The tests run outside the game, against a mock of the WoW client:

```sh
luajit tests/run.lua
```

See [tests/README.md](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/blob/main/tests/README.md).

### Releasing

Push a version tag. GitHub Actions runs the tests, then
[BigWigsMods/packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager) builds the zip and uploads
it to CurseForge and GitHub Releases.

```sh
git tag v0.1.0
git push origin v0.1.0
```

Tags with `alpha` or `beta` in them are uploaded as alpha or beta files.

## License

MIT. The bundled [LibEditMode](https://github.com/p3lim-wow/LibEditMode) keeps its own
license (`Libs/LibEditMode/LICENSE.txt`).

# Cooldown Manager Extras

## [v0.3.0](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/tree/v0.3.0) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/releases)

- CurseForge page: one line per paragraph, FAQ answers as paragraphs  
- README, CurseForge page and labelled screenshots  
    New pitch (extends Blizzard's Cooldown Manager in its own panels, pixel-perfect),  
    a CurseForge description with screenshot cards, and the generator that builds the cards  
    from raw screenshots (docs/screenshots/cards). docs/ is left out of the package.  
- Own-cast custom buffs, PRD bar spacing and shading, inner shadow, picker fixes  
    - Custom buffs: only buffs your own spells and item uses start, timed from the cast  
      (matched by cast GUID), so they also work in combat. Carried-over long buffs, other  
      players' buffs and passive procs are removed, with a migration for saved entries.  
    - Personal Resource Display, Square style: the space between bars is exactly Edit  
      Mode's Padding; options to turn off the spend flash and the full-power glow.  
    - Shading for the health and power bars (a vertical gradient), which also shades each  
      bar's background at half strength.  
    - Inner shadow (Shadow, Strength) for square icons and square PRD bars.  
    - Color pickers apply a typed hex value without Enter.  
    - Setting tooltips wrap; settings nest one level at most.  
    - /cme probe events logs the player's aura events for diagnosis.  
- Drop-zone anchoring, any Edit Mode frame as target, pixel-exact rows, regrouped settings  
    Anchoring:  
    - While dragging in Edit Mode, a preview shows where the frame will attach  
      (ghost, highlighted edge, "Attach below X, centered"); letting go attaches  
      it there. Dragging away detaches ("Detached" note); Shift moves without  
      attaching. Overlapping frames don't count as a drop.  
    - Any named Edit Mode frame can be a target (action bars, unit frames, cast  
      bar, LibEditMode add-on frames): dropdown, drop zones, Match Width.  
      Attachments that would loop through frame anchors are refused.  
    - Gap defaults to 0 (touching); existing attachments and old exports keep 2.  
    Pixel exactness:  
    - Icons placed by the add-on use Edit Mode's Icon Size rounded to whole  
      pixels; attached/pinned frames and frames others attach to are kept on the  
      pixel grid; the Personal Resource Display gets a whole-pixel width when  
      lined up with other frames. Rows, bars and borders no longer end a pixel  
      apart at UI scales other than 1.  
    Settings:  
    - Icon frames: Icons / Text / Keybinds sections. Tracked Bars: Icon / Bar  
      (with Bar Texture) / Text. The panel keeps one width.

# Cooldown Manager Extras

## [v0.2.0](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/tree/v0.2.0) (2026-11-16)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/releases)

- Custom entries, Personal Resource Display bar colors, debuff-color borders  
    Custom entries (Custom.lua, CustomSettings.lua):  
    - Add your own spells, items (potions, healthstones) and trinket slots to  
      Essential and Utility Cooldowns, and buffs (yours or from other players)  
      to Tracked Buffs. They show in the same row as Blizzard's icons, at the  
      place you pick, with the same look, keybinds and tooltips.  
    - Added and arranged in Blizzard's Cooldown Settings window: a + tile in  
      each section (menu with bag items, trinket slots, buffs and self-debuffs  
      seen on you; drop a spell or item on it), right-click a tile to place,  
      move, recolor or remove it.  
    - Buffs hidden from addons in combat are timed from your own cast, with  
      the trigger and duration learned out of combat.  
    - /cme probe spell|item|slot|aura  shows what addons can read now;  
      /cme probe aura lists your buffs and debuffs with their spell IDs.  
    Personal Resource Display:  
    - Health and power bars get their own texture (replaces the shared Bar  
      Texture; an old setting moves to both). Health in class or custom color,  
      a custom color per power type, and the cast cost preview's texture and  
      color. Blizzard's colored bar art is made gray so colors stay clean.  
    - Settings regrouped into Bar Style / Health Bar / Power Bar / Text.  
    Other:  
    - Square icons color their own border with the debuff type (learned per  
      spell) instead of drawing Blizzard's round ring.  
    - Tracked Buffs never wraps custom buffs into a second row.  
    - The Edit Mode panel keeps one width whichever section is open.

# Cooldown Manager Extras

## [v0.1.0](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/tree/v0.1.0) (2026-11-16)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/commits/v0.1.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/darfink/CooldownManagerExtras/releases)

- Link the CurseForge project (1809867)  
- CI: actions/checkout v5 (Node 24)  
- Rename to Cooldown Manager Extras; add license, README and CurseForge release workflow  
    - Folder/.toc/SavedVariables are now CooldownManagerExtras; /cme (with /cmp kept as alias).  
    - .toc version comes from the release tag (@project-version@).  
    - GitHub Actions: tests on push; on a v* tag, tests then BigWigsMods/packager  
      uploads to CurseForge (needs CF\_API\_KEY and X-Curse-Project-ID) and GitHub Releases.  
- Fix re-applied debuff timers, add /cmp timers and /cmp rings, square debuff rings  
    - Timers: any seen absence starts a new estimate (the 'short gap = same debuff'  
      guess failed in combat, where every shield hit updates the auras).  
    - Skin: in square style, Blizzard's debuff-type ring is shown on our own texture  
      exactly on the square icon (works with the secret atlas in combat).  
    - /cmp timers and /cmp rings diagnostics.  
- Add offline test harness (luajit tests/run.lua)  
- Cooldown Manager Plus: Edit Mode extensions for Blizzard's Cooldown Manager  
    Layout, anchoring and width matching for the cooldown viewers and the  
    Personal Resource Display; square icon and bar styles; per-spell styles;  
    debuff timers (with in-combat estimates from learned durations); gray-out  
    during a chosen lockout debuff; fonts and bar textures; keybind text;  
    profiles with import/export; blocked-action diagnostics.  
- Bundle LibEditMode (private, namespaced copy)
